features.name: Document Import
features.description: Users can import .txt and .md files via native file dialog (documents:pick-file -> documents:import)
features.evidence: Verified end-to-end via npm run dev on Windows / Electron 33: '+ Import' button opens native file dialog filtered to .txt/.md, selecting a file appends it to the sidebar (Documents count increments) and auto-selects it. Confirmed by user with two imports (PRODUCT.md, ARCHITECTURE.md) shown in the sidebar. Type-check and build also pass.

features.name: Document Detail with Content
features.description: DocumentDetail shows full document content (preserved newlines, scrollable), metadata, and a delete button
features.evidence: Verified end-to-end via npm run dev: clicking a document in the sidebar renders title, filename, importedAt, size, status, and the full markdown content with preserved newlines in a scrollable container (maxHeight 420px, overflow auto). Delete button visible and functional. Confirmed visually with ARCHITECTURE.md selected.

features.name: Basic Persistence
features.description: Imported documents persist across app restarts via filesystem storage; deletes remove all related files so deleted documents do not reappear
features.evidence: Verified end-to-end via npm run dev: after importing documents, closing the app, and relaunching, the sidebar list and per-document content are restored from documents-meta.json + content/{id}.txt. After clicking Delete on a document and restarting, the deleted document does not reappear (DocumentService.deleteDocument removes the meta entry plus content/{id}.txt and chunks/{id}.json via PersistenceService.deleteFile). Full TASK.md 5-step acceptance path confirmed by user.
